test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active form.

The entire cake was eaten by Maria.

options.text: Maria is eating the entire cake.
Maria was eating the entire cake.
Maria had eaten the entire cake.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "The entire cake was eaten by Maria."
 
• To convert it into active voice, place the original subject ("Maria") at the beginning.
 
• Change the verb "was eaten" to "ate" to maintain the past simple tense.
 
• Ensure that the object ("the entire cake") remains in place.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Maria ate the entire cake."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Maria is eating the entire cake." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to present continuous.
 
• **Option 2: **"Maria was eating the entire cake." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to past continuous.
 
• **Option 3: **"Maria had eaten the entire cake." – Incorrect as it changes the tense to past perfect.
